name: command-runner
description: Lists a repository's commands and runs them, in the foreground or as background jobs.

ompchamber.name: Runner
ompchamber.description: Lists a repository's commands and runs them, in the foreground or as background jobs.

logTailKb.label: Log tail (KB)
logTailKb.description: How much of a run's output the panel reads at a time. The full buffer is kept server-side; this is only what one read returns.

maxRuns.label: Concurrent runs
maxRuns.description: A run beyond this is refused with a reason rather than queued, so a runaway script cannot start a hundred processes.
